versions.content: Semantics of attribute DiagnosticAuthTransmitCertifi- cateEvaluation . evaluationId The attribute DiagnosticAuthTransmitCer- tificateEvaluation . evaluationId is used to define the evaluation id used for the sub-function transferCertificate (0x04). The value of this attribute is not standardized by either the ISO 14229-1 [17] or AUTOSAR and therefore has an OEM-specific meaning.
